activity.notes: Tuskaloosa was the paramount chief encountered by Hernando de Soto's expedition in 1540 and is associated with the confrontation culminating at Mabila. ATLAS uses 1540 as the securely documented personal activity point and does not make him ruler of all Mississippian peoples.
